item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 26/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
It will be persistently very hot over Guangdong in the next couple of days. High temperatures will also trigger showers. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China midweek this week. With the upper-air disturbance departing, the weather will be hot over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week to early next week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Shanshan will move in the general direction of the vicinity of western Japan in the next couple of days.
